title: Chemical heredity without genetic templates
summary: We prove two quantitative forms of chemical heredity that do not rely on copying a genetic sequence. In the first model, a population of four compartments carries three prescribed catalyst types that compete for a shared local fuel. Two types are present from the start; a third is supplied for a fixed seeding period, after which all catalyst input stops. We prove that, with failure probability at most 0.004517975690072193, a single finite-stock process acquires the third type and keeps all three present in both daughters of every division, delivers three million catalytic conversion credits…
